coeff.description: Linear coefficient for quadratic curve f(x) = c*x - x^2

b.description: Right boundary; its inclusive maximum is the sampled coeff value

constraints: f(x) = coeff*x - x^2 >= 0 for all x in [a, b]
b <= coeff ensures the region is nonnegative over [a, b]
promptTemplate: Define R as the region bounded above by the graph of f(x) = {coeff}x - x^2 and below by the x-axis over the interval [{a}, {b}]. Find the volume of the solid of revolution formed by revolving R around the y-axis.

hints.template: Identify the shell radius and shell height as functions of x for rotation around the y-axis.
For a region bounded by y = f(x) revolved around the y-axis, the shell radius is r(x) = x and the height is h(x) = {coeff}x - x^2.
Set up the definite integral: V = \int_{0}^{{b}} 2\pi x ({coeff}x - x^2) dx = 2\pi \int_{0}^{{b}} ({coeff}x^2 - x^3) dx.
Evaluate the antiderivative 2\pi [{coeff}*x^3/3 - x^4/4] from 0 to {b}.
